thread:
deploy-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: GPU OOM during prefill on model rwd-13B. Container restarted on gpunode-42. Affected hotpool: hotpool-12. Auto-pager triggered.

tim_oncall: Ack — I'm on it. Paging SRE and ops.

kelly_sre: Looking now. Can someone paste the failing request id / exemplar prompt?

deploy-bot: Logs snippet attached: `RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 31.8 GiB total capacity; 28.5 GiB already allocated)`
container stderr: "Killed by signal 9"
Hotpool restarts: 3 within 90s.

matt_ops: Traffic shows a burst of long-context prefill requests (seq len ~120k tokens) from a single customer key. Initiating mitigations: scale up hotpool + enable fallback for rwd-13B.
Command I'm running: `redwoodctl route set --model rwd-13B --fallback coldmodel-v1 --enable-circuit-breaker`

kelly_sre: Also trimming KV cache on the node to reclaim memory:
```
kubectl exec -n inference pod/gpunode-42 -- /opt/bin/kv-trim --target-percent=50
```
Running now.

emily_cs: Customer-facing note (sent): "We detected transient errors for very long prompts in the last ~5m. We've routed those requests to a fallback model and applied protections. Some requests returned 502/timeout. No user data lost. We're monitoring and expect recovery within ~30m."

leo_eng: Adding temporary edge limit to drop extreme prefill sizes: `prefill.max_tokens=50000` and rejecting requests above that at the gateway. Pushing config in 15s.

tim_oncall: Edge rule deployed. Observability: error rate fell from ~12% -> ~2% in the last 2 minutes. Some customers still see 502s for in-flight sessions. Keeping an eye on restarts.

kelly_sre: Runbook note: if the same node repeats crashes, cordon and drain it:
```
kubectl cordon gpunode-42
kubectl drain gpunode-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Will tag node for postmortem.

matt_ops: Hotpool capacity + fallback applied. Also enabled short-term prefill throttling on the ingress for keys with high prefill rates. Monitoring GPU mem, prefill queue depth, and container restart counts.

deploy-bot: Auto-restart prevented after 3rd consecutive crash on gpunode-42; node flagged with severity=high for manual inspection.

tim_oncall: Good mitigation work. Handoff: leaving notes for night ops in 8h. If spikes recur, escalate to infra-leads and consider immediate coldmodel-only routing for affected customer keys. Logging this thread for the incident timeline. :thumbsup: 

matt_ops: Quick checklist added to channel: investigate request pattern, customer key, release client-side guidance, and schedule node postmortem.

emily_cs: I'll follow up with the impacted customer with an after-action note once we have root cause.

tim_oncall: Closing active pager for now — moving to monitoring state. Handoff complete. :coffee:
